{{Quote|Anticipate the moves your foe can make and then narrow them to the moves you want them to make. Take nothing for granted.|Admiral Krion Grail|<ref name="Legacy 42" />}}
'''Krion Grail''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]]. At the time of the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], Grail was the commanding officer of the [[First Coruscant Task Force]], with the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Shantillen]] as second in command. Grail was later transferred to the [[Outer Rim Third Fleet]].

==Biography==
===Hunting down Admiral Stazi===
{{Quote|If everything is going according to that plan, Admiral Stazi is dead, and his command deck is in confusion.|Admiral Grail|<ref name="Legacy 42" />}}
[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] Krion Grail was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]]. By the year [[137 ABY]], and after [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Morlish Veed]] had been appointed [[Regent/Legends|Regent]] of the Empire by [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok]], Grail led the First Coruscant Task Force in a [[Attack on the Galactic Alliance Core Fleet|chase]] of the [[Core Fleet|Galactic Alliance fleet]], using their comm frequencies provided by a traitor as beacons to learn the location of their fleet.<ref name="Legacy 42" />

Grail had also plotted the assassinate the [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] and leader of the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]], [[Gar Stazi]]. The [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] was a shipman of Stazi's own crew, the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Tealart]], whose family had been imprisoned by Imperial forces in [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] and faced execution if Tealart did not cooperate. Tealart had sabotaged the fleet's deep-space alarms, ensuring the Alliance had no warning when Grail's task force emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and opened fire. The Mon Calamari drew a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and shot Stazi, leaving him severely injured.<ref name="Legacy 42" />

After chasing the Alliance fleet all the way to the [[Opoku system]], Grail followed the rebels to the [[Teraab sector/Legends|Teraab sector]] and found the Remnant flagship, the [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|''Alliance'']]. From the bridge of the [[Ardent-class fast frigate|''Ardent''-class fast frigate]] [[Marauder (Ardent-class)|''Marauder'']], Grail's flagship, the admiral attempted to convince Gar Stazi's second, [[Jhoram Bey]], to surrender. However, the injured Stazi had discovered how the fleet was being tracked, allowing Bey to use this information to turn the tables on the Imperial task force: the Galactic Alliance fleet jumped out of hyperspace behind Grail's fleet and proceeded to devastate it. Outmaneuvered, Grail furiously gave the order for the battered Imperial forces to retreat.<ref name="Legacy 42" />

===Battle at Dac===
{{Quote|Five enemy ships approaching our position, Moff Geist. Speed increasing and sensors show no life signs. Droid bombs, no doubt. Pitiful.|Krion Grail|<ref name="Legacy 47" />}}
Krion Grail later joined [[Darth Stryfe]] and [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Geist (Moff)|Geist]] aboard the [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Relentless (Pellaeon-class)|''Relentless'']] to lead the Outer Rim Third Fleet in an effort to thwart Admiral Stazi's plan to [[Evacuation of Dac|evacuate]] the world of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], which had been infected by the Sith with a pathogen that would eliminate all life on it.<ref name="Legacy 47" />

As the confrontation between the Third Fleet and Stazi's forces began, a number of ships approached the Sith Imperials' position. Grail informed Moff Geist and Lord Stryfe that the sensors showed no life signs aboard and was certain that Stazi had launched droid bombs, a pitiful move in Grail's opinion. At Geist's orders, the Imperial ships opened fire, only to cause the explosion of several ion bombs, which damaged the Third Fleet's sensors, leaving them blind. Grail immediately ordered all ships to divert all their power to their shields. Stryfe reprimanded the Admiral that Stazi's "pitiful" maneuver had caused five of their ships to be put out of commission or destroyed, but Grail defended the orders, saying the shields had prevented their ship from suffering the same fate.<ref name="Legacy 47" />

As the first wave of the Alliance's [[Emergency evac fleet|evacuation fleet]] began their run, Stryfe gave the orders to intercept. One of the refugee ships was destroyed, prompting Stazi to move the ''Alliance'' between the escaping freighters and Imperial fire. As the Imperial's concentrated their fire on the ''Alliance'', a fleet under the command of [[Empire-in-exile|Fel-loyalist]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Oron Jaeger]] emerged from hyperspace to aid Stazi. Outnumbered and severely damaged, the Outer Rim Third Fleet withdrew from the battle.<ref name="Legacy 47" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|With Veed now the Regent, the post of Grand Admiral should become vacant. And planning is the reason it will be mine. It's what the Sith do. We can learn from them.|Admiral Grail|<ref name="Legacy 42" />}}
[[File:Krion_Grail.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Krion Grail on the bridge of the ''Marauder'']]
Krion Grail was an ambitious and calculating man who sought to obtain the post of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]]. Unlike several fellow officers, the admiral admired the members of the [[One Sith]] due to their penchant for plotting and planning beforehand. Grail preferred to weaken the Empire's enemies from within and drive them to act in a way planned by Grail, rather than simply overpowering them with numbers and firepower, thus risking defeat. However, the admiral was arrogant and did not expect to be outwitted; as a result, Grail lost important Imperial objectives to the Galactic Alliance, such as destroying the Alliance and holding Dac.
